rationale: The position is currently in profit (+0.84%) and trading above the session VWAP ($298.62), indicating that the initial thesis of buying absorption from the gap-down low remains intact. Although price has pulled back from the session high of $305.45 and is currently testing the 9-EMA ($300.91) from below, the lack of a decisive break below the VWAP or the invalidation level at $290.50 suggests the uptrend is consolidating rather than reversing. With 145 minutes remaining in the session and no new negative news, holding allows the trade to either reach the take-profit at $305.00 or be stopped out if the support fails.
